title: Drug proceeds held in a stablecoin and cashed out through company accounts
summary: A broker sends drug proceeds in a stablecoin to the launderer, who holds them and then trades them at an exchange with weak checks. Shell companies take them out as cash.

basis.note: A case follows one slice of the proceeds. The slice is sized so that the last company could take most of it out in cash at a counter over several days, and its range is assumed.

references.note: The report describes each method separately. The library combines them as an example.
